newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Aug weekly earnings rise 2.6 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada Aug weekly earnings rise 2.6 pct on year.

text.p: The preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 2.6 percent in August from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$590.16, Statistics Canada said on Monday.
From the month before, earnings rose 0.3 percent.
Seasonally adjusted payroll employment fell 0.4 percent in August to 10.87 million from a revised 10.91 million in July.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that average weekly earnings would rise by 2.7 percent, year on year, after July's 2.4 percent rise.
